description: Java class implementing a FreeMarker template transform for generating alternative URLs for content in the OFBiz framework, including methods for URL construction based on content ID and associated data.

classes.name: OfbizContentAltUrlTransforms
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel to generate alternative content URLs based on content ID and associated data.

methods.name: getStringArg
methods.description: Retrieves a string argument from a map of arguments, handling different object types.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer that processes template output, generating URLs based on request and response objects.

methods.name: makeContentAltUrl
methods.description: Constructs an alternative URL for content based on associated data resource or falls back to a default URL.

methods.name: makeContentUrl
methods.description: Builds a URL for content display based on request context, view content, and content ID.
